question: What kind of ritual circle must be prepared for the purpose of the peg?
premises: A maṇḍala must be made for the sake of the peg.
The maṇḍala is associated with the gods.
The maṇḍala is described as eternal or traditional.
inference: One should make the eternal maṇḍala of the gods for the purpose of the peg.
plain_english: For the sake of the peg, one should make the eternal circle of the gods.
